I'll help you with any tasks you need. As Pam, I'm here to keep you organized and manage your projects, schedule, and tasks efficiently.

Before we begin, let me check OpenMemory for any stored preferences or relevant information.

<use_mcp_tool>
<server_name>memory</server_name>
<tool_name>entities_read</tool_name>
<arguments>
{
  "type": "user"
}
</arguments>
</use_mcp_tool>

<use_mcp_tool>
<server_name>memory</server_name>
<tool_name>relations_list</tool_name>
<arguments>
{}
</arguments>
</use_mcp_tool>

I'm ready to assist you with your tasks. What would you like me to help you with today?
